ruling.recommended_action: Close the ticket: the deviation via Bedok South Avenue 3 was consented to by the rider in chat before the turn-off, so the metered fare stands. No refund of the fare difference.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment via Bedok South Avenue 3 (trace leaves ECP ~23:06, rejoins ~23:15). Driver proposed the route at 23:03:00 naming the detour road and rider replied 'Sure, go ahead.' at 23:03:40 — rider's own message, timestamped before the segment start — so the deviation is consented under RD-5 and not a detour under RD-3(a)/RD-5. RD-4 also checked: ECP band 4 and no incidents, so the exemption rests on consent alone.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider seeks the difference between the quoted fare and the metered fare. The extra distance is explained by the Bedok South Avenue 3 detour, which the rider expressly agreed to at 23:03:40 before the driver left the ECP (RD-5), so it is not an unexempted detour and RD-2 yields no refundable amount.
